hook: Inter exams are being *pulled forward*: theory from Feb 24.
hook_b: Inter exams are being *pulled forward*: theory from Feb 24.
tldr: Telangana is likely to bring forward the 2027 Intermediate exams, with theory papers starting Feb 24.

beats.what: The state is set to advance the 2027 Intermediate Public Examinations, theory likely from Wednesday, Feb 24; practicals likely earlier.
beats.why: An earlier calendar changes how much time students get before entrance exams.
beats.care: If you or someone at home is in Inter, plan revision backward from Feb 24. The schedule is not final.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat reports the government is likely to advance the 2027 IPE, with theory papers likely from Feb 24. The official timetable is not out yet.

cards.q: Inter exams moving earlier. How does that hit you?

learn.t: IPE stands for Intermediate Public Examination, the Class 11-12 board exam run by Telangana's intermediate board.
